shortDescription: SBI has released the Junior Associates Clerk Backlog Recruitment 2026 admit card for 1538 posts. Enrolled candidates can download the Phase I preliminary exam hall ticket.
content:
State Bank of India (SBI) has released the admit card for the Junior Associates Clerk Backlog Recruitment 2026. Candidates enrolled for the 1538 backlog posts can download their Phase I preliminary examination admit card from the official IBPS registration portal.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 07/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 27/08/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 27/08/2026
  • SBI Clerk Phase I Preliminary Exam Date: 16/09/2026
  • Admit Card Available: 09/09/2026
  • Phase II Main Exam: October / November 2026

Eligibility and Vacancy

Applicants must have passed or be appearing in a Bachelor's Degree in any stream from a recognized university. The recruitment includes 1538 backlog vacancies for SBI Junior Associates.

Before the Exam

  • Download and print the admit card.
  • Check the examination centre, date, shift and reporting time.
  • Carry the admit card and a valid photo identity proof.
  • Follow all instructions printed on the hall ticket.

State-wise Vacancy Summary

Backlog vacancies are distributed across Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Chandigarh, Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Assam and Tripura, subject to the official notification.

Read the official SBI Junior Associates Clerk Backlog Recruitment 2026 notification for complete eligibility, state-wise vacancies and examination instructions.
